info.text: 40% chance for tears, lasers, and knives to record an enemy's movement direction
Chance scales up to 100% at 8 Luck
An enemy that reverses direction for 3 frames shatters into a salt statue
Bosses trigger the shatter but take 5x Isaac's damage instead
Attacks cycle through Father, Son, and Spirit
Son deals 1.5x damage; 3x against Father's Mark, then applies Son's Mark
Spirit hitting both marks triggers Judgment: 5x hit, 2x area damage, clears marks
Two temporary Treasure Room items appear in each floor's starting room
Choose one before leaving; refusing has no penalty
Each choice costs one heart container; Keepers pay the native coin price
For this floor: -0/10/20/30/40% damage based on the chosen item's quality
